newsitem.title: CHILE: CHILE SHARES CLOSE LOWER AS LABCHILE FALLS.
newsitem.headline: CHILE SHARES CLOSE LOWER AS LABCHILE FALLS.

text.p: Chilean blue chips zigzagged before closing lower on Wednesday, with LabChile tumbling after the drugmaker's chief executive unexpectedly resigned, traders said.
The bolsa is expectd to be unstable in coming sessions as attention starts focusing on the U.S. Federal Reserve meeting set for August 19, they said.
The weighted .IPSA index closed down 0.37 percent at 130.54 points. The general .IGPA index shed 0.44 percent to 5,582.26 points.
Turnover rose to 11.4 billion pesos from 9.6 billion pesos Tuesday.
Traders said share prices tracked Wall Street stocks downwards in late trade, with most Chilean-issued American Despositary Receipts (ADRs) closing softer.
LabChile plummeted in Santiago and New York after news that Rodolfo Ham, its recently appointed general manager, quit amid disagreements over the company's development plans, traders said.
"Investors, especially in New York, usually punish stocks when there are sudden changes in management," a dealer said.
